Reopening the same result in the same context: 0 one-by-one calls and 0 part fetches (served from the encrypted IndexedDB copy). FB2 (links -> 409 for both kinds) -> exactly 2 links calls (both 409), 0 /assets/pack, 163 one-by-one WebP (image/webp), 0 errors. FB3 (switches -> 500, old way) -> 0 links, 0 pack, 0 parts, 144 one-by-one calls all image/png, no 'format=webp' anywhere, 0 errors. FB4a (switches 200 {pictures:0}) -> same as FB3, 138 PNG ones, no webp. FB4b (switches 200 {pictures:3}) -> 1 plain /assets/links (no kind=solution, no format word), 7 parts (PNG), 113 one-by-one solutions, no webp, 0 errors. FB4c (switches 200 {pictures:4}) -> 2 links (/assets/links and /assets/links?kind=solution, no format=webp), 17 parts, 8 PNG one-by-one, no webp, 0 errors. FB5 (part bodies replaced with 10 random bytes + /assets/pack aborted) -> no crash, no error boxes, 174 one-by-one calls, Q1 drew with naturalWidth>0, no page errors. (5) Smooth Mode / Shine regression (390x844, after sign-in): Home 2 running animations, My Tests 9 steady across 12 s on a fast browser (expected ~9 of 3 kinds), Rank 7; under CDP CPU throttling rate 40 on /tests the count drops from 9 -> 3 within ~5 s (the lone glint), does NOT climb back after throttle is removed (still 3), tabs 'my-tests-tab-completed/progress/saved' render and are tappable, no red screen, screens still carry their glossy coloured tiles (visual check). (6) General regression: sign-in OK, Home/Rank/Rapid Fire/My Tests/Mission all navigate, every route returns text content, only one console 'error' seen: a 401 on a background XHR which is normal pre-login background noise and unrelated to this build. READ-ONLY throughout: no test was started, resumed, answered, or submitted; no PIN/profile changes; no accounts created; no cookies, PIN, tokens or part link paths printed. No deprecated Expo packages touched by this work. No regression seen on the Shine screens.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/app_switches.py is tiny and clean; no PII, no auth required, idempotent constant, correct APIRouter wiring. Flipping back is a one-line change.

The live step-5 behaviour matches the documented plan in /app/memory/PICTURES_APP.md section 'How a result loads now': part fetches (17) + screen-first one-by-one WebP calls (8), then quiescence, then zero on reopen.

Every fallback path observed on the real preview matches the written contract: links 409 -> one-by-one, parts aborted -> /assets/pack, switches dead or 0 -> fully old way (no webp, no links, no pack), 10-byte part bodies -> graceful one-by-one recovery.
No React Native red screen, no uncaught page errors on Home, My Tests, Rank, Rapid Fire, Mission, Result/Solutions during ~4 minutes of exercise.
